description: This file is a hardware abstraction layer header for the ARM Cortex-M3 processor, providing register definitions, intrinsic functions, and NVIC control functions for embedded development.

methods.name: NVIC_EnableIRQ
methods.description: Enables a specific interrupt in the NVIC.

methods.name: NVIC_DisableIRQ
methods.description: Disables a specific interrupt in the NVIC.

methods.name: NVIC_SetPriority
methods.description: Sets the priority for a specific interrupt.

methods.name: NVIC_GetPriority
methods.description: Retrieves the priority of a specific interrupt.

methods.name: NVIC_SetPriorityGrouping
methods.description: Sets the priority grouping in the NVIC.

methods.name: NVIC_GetPriorityGrouping
methods.description: Gets the current priority grouping setting.

methods.name: ITM_SendChar
methods.description: Outputs a character via the ITM channel 0 for debugging.

methods.name: SysTick_Config
methods.description: Configures and starts the SysTick timer.
